description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different versions of the Darija Open Dataset. There are five slices in total, each corresponding to a different version of the dataset. The largest slice, representing Version 2, accounts for 45,387 entries. The second largest slice, representing Version 1, has 43,000 entries. Version 3 has 30,000 entries, Version 4 has 23,108 entries, and the smallest slice, representing Version 0, has 1,000 entries. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any visual emphasis on specific slices. The segments are ordered by size, with the largest slice at the top and the smallest at the bottom.
